mapper.select: SELECT vbcs.plan_id, scs.timeline_key, vbcs.entry_facts_json::text AS entry_facts_json, vbcs.visible_facts_json::text AS visible_facts_json, vbcs.exit_facts_json::text AS exit_facts_json, vbcs.event_keys_json::text AS event_keys_json, vbcs.semantic_hash FROM visual_beat_continuity_states vbcs JOIN chapter_continuity_plans ccp ON ccp.id = vbcs.plan_id JOIN scene_continuity_states scs ON scs.plan_id = vbcs.plan_id AND scs.scene_id = vbcs.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = vbcs.chapter_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = ch.story_version_id WHERE vbcs.visual_beat_id = #{visualBeatId} AND vbcs.project_id = #{projectId} AND ccp.project_id = #{projectId} AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND ch.current_storyboard_revision_id = ccp.storyboard_revision_id AND ch.source_hash = ccp.source_hash ORDER BY ccp.revision DESC LIMIT 1
